display_mode.description: The display format for binary data, either 'hex' for hexadecimal or 'binary' for raw binary representation.

character_set.description: The character encoding to use for the text column, either 'ascii' or 'ebcdic'.

font_size.description: The font size in points used for the main display window.

highlight_invert.description: When true, differences are highlighted by inverting colors; when false, they use a solid block color.

color_theme_file.description: Path to a custom color theme file. Leave empty to use the built-in default theme.

editor_cmd.description: Command to invoke as the external text editor when the user presses 'E'. Leave empty to use the default system editor.
